dishes.name: Liège waffle
dishes.desc: Dense, chewy yeast waffle with caramelised pearl sugar, eaten warm from street stalls. It is Liège's best-known food.

dishes.name: Boulets liégeois
dishes.desc: Large meatballs in a sweet-sour sauce of Liège syrup, onion and apple, served with fries.

dishes.name: Salade liégeoise
dishes.desc: Warm salad of green beans, potatoes, bacon and vinegar, a Liège home dish.

dishes.name: Herve cheese
dishes.desc: Strong washed-rind cheese from the plateau east of Liège, made since the Middle Ages. Soft and pungent.

dishes.name: Sirop de Liège
dishes.desc: Thick dark syrup of apples and pears, spread on bread or used in cooking. A Walloon pantry staple.

dishes.name: Tarte au riz
dishes.desc: Rice-pudding tart from Verviers and the East Cantons, sold in bakeries.
